soundness_flags.label: def:frontier-estimator; def:honest-interval; Theorem 3
soundness_flags.one_line: The claimed total procedures are not samplewise defined: with only a fourth-moment donor law a fold center can leave [0,1]^d, and the construction gives neither a measurable fallback when no coercive bandwidth exists nor an explicit interval formula/radius, so hat_tau and C_alpha are not yet defined on every sample.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: lem:causal-identification and Theorems 1–3
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Event-date transport, E[B_si(0)|z_0]=m_s(z_0s), is an untestable cross-date counterfactual premise rather than a consequence of the observed panel.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: All causal identification, frontier, and interval claims are conditional on event-date transport; rolling pseudo-events can only diagnose pre-event stability.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Theorems 1–3; ass:attainable-local-modulus
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The lower covariance-standardized modulus supplying the N^{-kappa} converse is a maintained one-direction condition, not derived from Holder smoothness or the remaining panel primitives.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The four-channel MSE and expected-length equivalences are conditional on ass:attainable-local-modulus; because this focal rate channel is assumed, the proposal is capped at field tier.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Make the estimator and interval genuinely total: project or extend donor centers outside the cube, state a measurable no-coercion fallback, and give an explicit block-length, variance-radius, and critical-value formula for C_alpha.
Add a scalar corollary that formally contrasts the exact-center, generated-center, and all-training-coordinates-noisy experiments, stating which term changes and when deconvolution is unavoidable.
Strengthen the field case by proving the random-design spacing lower bound on a named quasi-uniform or density-bounded subclass before assembling the four-channel lower bound.

recommended_next_step: Revise the samplewise definitions of the estimator and confidence interval, then retain the conditional field-tier four-channel frontier for Stage 0.
